headline: Oil slips over 1% amid continuing talks to end Iran conflict
summary: Oil prices dropped by more than 1% as negotiations continued regarding potential resolutions to the conflict involving Iran.
why: Geopolitical developments in major oil-producing regions directly influence global crude supply expectations and commodity pricing.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Oil prices decline on news of potential resolution to supply-disrupting conflicts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Progress in talks to end the Iran conflict eases fears of severe supply disruptions in the Middle East, reducing risk premiums in the oil market.
